name: Gram Silver
oneLiner: GRAMS is Token Teknoloji's gram-silver stablecoin from Turkey, backed by one gram of physical silver per token held at Turkish bank custodians.
collateral: One gram of physical silver per GRAMS, with Token Teknoloji proof pages listing silver held at Kuveyt Türk, VakıfBank, Ziraat Participation, and Akbank
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint/redeem and exchange conversion route for a one-gram silver claim; public materials support reserve backing but do not expose a reviewed direct holder redemption schedule suitable for a Pharos backstop config

proofOfReserves.provider: Token Teknoloji reserve proof page (no reserve figure renders - empty supply widget; page reuses GRAMG's contract address and contains leftover platinum copy; custody described as company vaults, contradicting the shared PoR page's named banks)

listingStatusReview.reason: Temporarily withheld because permitted runtime sources do not provide a positive circulating supply or market cap.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GRAMS is a one-gram silver claim: Token Teknoloji's proof pages list physical silver held at Kuveyt Türk, VakıfBank, Ziraat Participation, and Akbank against issued tokens. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14; the owner ruling scopes the archetype to all direct commodity claims, silver included. The coin carries no curated mechanism overlay, so its commodity components stay on the conservative compiler fallback.
